info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Realestate Listings Agents-v1-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings by Agent API enables users to retrieve a comprehensive list of real estate listings associated with specific agents. This API serves real estate professionals and potential buyers, facilitating easy access to property information curated by particular agents. It allows consumers to efficiently explore offerings, empowering them to make informed decisions in the housing market. Utilize this endpoint to gather essential data on properties, enhancing the overall real estate experience.

get.summary: Retrieve listings associated with a specific agent.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all property listings that are managed by a particular agent, providing a comprehensive view of their available properties.

requestBody.description: A request to retrieve listings associated with a specific agent. The body should contain the necessary parameters to filter and request the listings data.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the list of agent listings.
